title: Design System: 금고은행 입찰 현황 히트맵

title.purpose: The h1 app title only (16px/700, -0.01em), paired with the 14px teal SVG logo glyph.

body.purpose: Default UI text, card names, chat, table cells (13px).

control.purpose: Buttons, inputs, tabs, filter labels, ticker (12px).

caption.purpose: Badges, hints, timestamps (11px); --mono when the content is a count, date, or code.

micro-label.purpose: Strip titles like '기관 분류선택' and the legend title (10px, +0.08em, muted).

data-mono.purpose: Consolas tabular for every figure, date, and D-day (The Tabular Ledger Rule).

shadows.name: ambient-panel
shadows.purpose: Resting shadow (--shadow) for map stage, ranking panel, modal boxes, popover.

shadows.name: button-lift
shadows.purpose: Button hover, with translateY(-1px); removed on :active.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: Region-card hover, with translateY(-2px) and border warming toward teal.

shadows.name: glass-legend
shadows.purpose: Inner top highlight + soft drop on the glass map legend.

shadows.name: selection-bar
shadows.purpose: Left accent bar on the highlighted ranking row (.hi).

shadows.name: state-ring
shadows.purpose: Current/gate workflow-step ring (orange variant for gates) — outline, not elevation.

shadows.name: watch-glow
shadows.purpose: SVG glow filter on watched-region outlines; a signal, not elevation.

motion.name: entrance-fade-up
motion.purpose: One staggered load entrance: header/topbar/ticker/map at 0/60/120/180ms delays; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: All hover/state transitions on buttons, tabs, cards, rows (background, border-color, transform, box-shadow).

motion.name: ripple-duration
motion.purpose: CSS var --ripple-duration: period of the triple ripple rings (phase-offset by thirds) and municipality blink; user-tunable 1–4s via the theme modal.

motion.name: cloud-fade
motion.purpose: Radial cloud overlay opacity during map drill-in.

motion.name: drill-zoom
motion.purpose: d3 zoom fly-in when drilling into a region.

breakpoints.name: stack
breakpoints.purpose: Frame unlocks and scrolls; tab pill wraps; topbar stacks; ranking drops below map; map labels shrink to 10px and hide the 준비중 sub-line.

components.name: Default Button
components.description: The default button style; hierarchy comes from placement. Single sanctioned filled-primary exception: #ch-send (chat send) in solid teal + on-accent ink (2026-08-14, user-confirmed).
components.css: .ds-btn { background: #1a2029; color: #e2e7ee; border: 1px solid #2e3745; border-radius: 10px; padding: 6px 14px; font-family: 'Malgun Gothic', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; transition: background .2s, border-color .2s, transform .2s, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-btn:hover { background: #202836; border-color: #3a4557; transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(8,12,24,.4); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(0) scale(.98); box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #57b8ad; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Recessed well with teal caret; shared skin for text, date, number, select.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #0d1117; color: #e2e7ee; border: 1px solid #2e3745; border-radius: 8px; padding: 5px 10px; font-family: 'Malgun Gothic', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; caret-color: #57b8ad; accent-color: #57b8ad; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8b94a3; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #57b8ad; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Tabs
components.description: Pill-in-pill header navigation; active tab is a 16% teal tint, never a lift.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; background: #151a22; border: 1px solid #232a35; border-radius: 12px; padding: 3px; } .ds-tab { background: transparent; color: #8b94a3; border: none; border-radius: 9px; padding: 6px 16px; font-family: 'Malgun Gothic', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s, color .2s; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #e2e7ee; } .ds-tab.active { background: color-mix(in srgb, #57b8ad 16%, transparent); color: #e2e7ee; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #57b8ad; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: The 18% Tint Rule: colored text + 1px same-color border + 18% color-mix background; never a solid fill.
components.html: 확보 보완 누락
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; border-radius: 8px; padding: 1px 7px; font-family: 'Malgun Gothic', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; border: 1px solid; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge.ok { color: #7c93c4; border-color: #7c93c4; background: color-mix(in srgb, #7c93c4 18%, transparent); } .ds-badge.gap { color: #d9a05b; border-color: #d9a05b; background: color-mix(in srgb, #d9a05b 18%, transparent); } .ds-badge.none { color: #e07856; border-color: #e07856; background: color-mix(in srgb, #e07856 18%, transparent); }

components.name: Watch Pin
components.description: Draggable watched-region pin in the teal interaction voice with an inline star glyph.
components.html: 서울
components.css: .ds-pin { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #57b8ad 13%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #57b8ad 55%, transparent); color: #57b8ad; border-radius: 10px; padding: 5px 12px; cursor: grab; font-family: 'Malgun Gothic', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; transition: transform .2s; } .ds-pin:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); }

components.name: Ranking Row
components.description: The drill-in institution ladder row: hairline-separated, slides right on hover, teal bar + tint when selected.
components.html:
성동구청
지자체 · 2026-11 예상
서울시립대학교
대학교 · 2027-03 예상
components.css: .ds-rank { background: #151a22; border: 1px solid #232a35; border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(8,12,24,.55); overflow: hidden; font-family: 'Malgun Gothic', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; min-width: 240px; } .ds-rank-row { padding: 9px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid #232a35; cursor: pointer; color: #e2e7ee; transition: background .2s, transform .2s; } .ds-rank-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; } .ds-rank-row b { font-size: 13px; } .ds-rank-row small { color: #8b94a3; font-family: Consolas, 'Cascadia Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; } .ds-rank-row:hover { background: #1a2130; transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-rank-row.hi { background: color-mix(in srgb, #57b8ad 13%, transparent); box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 #57b8ad; } .ds-heart { float: right; color: #e07856; cursor: pointer; }

components.name: Glass Legend
components.description: The map's floating instrument panel: real glass (blur + white-alpha edge + inner highlight), mono captions, band-colored labels lightened 70% toward white.
components.html:
입찰 임박도
6개월↓1년↓2년↓2년+
components.css: .ds-legend { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; background: rgba(21,26,34,.68); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.06), 0 8px 24px rgba(8,12,24,.45); padding: 9px 12px; font-family: Consolas, 'Cascadia Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; } .ds-lg-title { color: #8b94a3; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .08em; margin-bottom: 1px; } .ds-lg-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-lg-sw { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.35); display: inline-block; }

components.name: Region Card
components.description: Grid card for the 전국 지역별 tab: flat at rest, teal-warmed border + tinted lift on hover, gold watch star.
components.html:
서울
기관 34곳 · 구/시군 보기 →
components.css: .ds-card { background: #151a22; border: 1px solid #232a35; border-radius: 12px; padding: 13px 14px; min-width: 170px; color: #e2e7ee; font-family: 'Malgun Gothic', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .2s, transform .2s, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #57b8ad 55%, transparent); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(8,12,24,.4); } .ds-card .ds-star { float: right; color: #d8c47a; cursor: pointer; } .ds-card-sub { color: #8b94a3; font-size: 12px; margin-top: 6px; }

narrative.northStar: 프리미엄 다크 크롬 + 파스텔 지도 (Premium Dark Chrome, Pastel Map)
narrative.overview:
The chrome is a quiet, premium dark instrument case: tinted charcoal (#0f1218) rather than black, hairline-bordered panels, a faint SVG-noise grain over everything, soft 8–14px corners, glassy overlays, and shadows tinted toward the room's own blue-charcoal. On that near-achromatic stage, the national map is the only saturated object — a pastel five-band urgency palette (inherited from the 1.0 report's palette, user-themable) that reads instantly because nothing around it competes. The thesis, from the direction contract: a dashboard whose chrome is louder than its data is rejected; saturation is reserved for the data (urgency).

One color speaks for interaction everywhere: teal (#57b8ad) — active-tab tint, focus rings, selection ripples and municipality blink, watch pins, search marks, caret, ::selection. It is the most saturated hue on screen precisely because it appears in small doses. The story shape follows: a staff member passes through colorless chrome straight to the colored map, clicks an imminent region, and picks an institution from the ranking panel into the workflow.

This remains an Operate-mode working tool as well as a demo. Density is kept — a tight 10–16px type ramp, tabular Consolas for every figure — but the finish is soft: 200ms lift-on-hover controls, one staggered entrance, real backdrop-blur glass. Hard product constraints carry into the visuals: closed network (no CDN, no webfonts — system faces only), vanilla JS, and DOM ids/classes coupled to the node test suite (244 tests).
keyCharacteristics: Tinted-charcoal chrome in three tonal steps + hairlines + grain overlay (0.045 opacity)
Saturation monopoly: the pastel urgency map is the only saturated element; teal (#57b8ad) is the single interaction voice
Two-tier urgency color: pastel tier for map fills (runtime-themable via render.applyTheme()), muted deep tier for chrome badges
Real glass (blur + 1px white-alpha edge + inner highlight) and tinted shadows (rgba(8,12,24,…)), never pure black
Soft geometry: 8/10/14px radius scale, pill segmented tabs; Malgun Gothic UI + Consolas tabular numerals

rules.name: The Saturation Monopoly Rule
rules.body: Chrome stays tinted-achromatic. Full saturation exists in exactly two places: the pastel map (data) and the teal accent (interaction). Status color in chrome appears only as muted-tier text, 1px borders, and ≤18% tints — never as a solid saturated fill.

rules.name: The One Teal Rule
rules.body: Teal is reserved for selection, focus, and interaction. It never encodes urgency; urgency hues never encode selection.

rules.name: The Two-Tier Urgency Rule
rules.body: Large fills (map faces) use the pastel tier; small chrome (badges, tags, ticker, legend swatches) uses the muted deep tier. Small text set in a band color over dark ground is lightened with color-mix(in srgb, <band> 70–72%, #ffffff) — the legend and ticker both do this; copy the pattern rather than brightening the token.

rules.name: The 18% Tint Rule
rules.body: Status chips are colored text + 1px same-color border + color-mix(in srgb, <band> 18%, transparent) background. Status rows use the same mix at 8–12%; teal selections use 13–16%. Status is never a solid colored fill.

rules.name: The Variable-Name Freeze Rule
rules.body: The :root custom-property names (--bg, --panel, --panel2, --line, --line-strong, --fg, --muted, --red, --orange, --yellow, --blue, --gray, --accent-color, --ripple-duration, --mono) are load-bearing: JS-generated inline markup references them by name and render.applyTheme() writes --accent-color and --ripple-duration at runtime. Change values to restyle; never rename.

rules.name: The Tabular Ledger Rule
rules.body: Anything that is a figure — D-day, dates, counts, numbered badges, the ticker — is set in --mono (Consolas) so columns of data align like a ledger.

rules.name: The Tight Operate Ramp Rule
rules.body: The type ramp is deliberately compressed to 10–16px (Operate-mode density; the 16px title is its ceiling, added at finish review for demo presence). This is a committed decision, not an oversight: the flat-type-hierarchy detector finding is suppressed as a sanctioned exception in .impeccable/config.json. Do not introduce larger display sizes in app chrome to "fix" hierarchy; use weight, color, and spacing.

rules.name: The One Entrance Rule
rules.body: The page animates in once, lightly — header → topbar → ticker → map stage at 0/60/120/180ms delays, 0.5s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.3,1), disabled under prefers-reduced-motion; nothing re-animates on tab switches or data refresh.

rules.name: The Tinted Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow in the system is cast in rgba(8,12,24,…). Never introduce a neutral rgba(0,0,0,…) drop shadow.

rules.name: The Real Glass Rule
rules.body: Glass surfaces are built from all three parts — translucent panel tone + backdrop-filter: blur(8–10px) + 1px white-alpha edge (plus inner highlight where floating). A translucent fill alone is not glass.

dos: Do reference tokens as var(--…) in generated markup — --accent-color and --ripple-duration change at runtime, and the five map bands come from render.URGENCY_COLORS (theme-merged, identity-stable), not from constants.
Do pass any color that originated in localStorage through render._safeColor() before interpolating it into HTML/inline styles.
Do keep every shadow tinted rgba(8,12,24,…), hover lifts at translateY(-1/-2px), and state transitions at 200ms.
Do set every figure, date, and D-day in --mono; signal status with colored text + 1px border + 8–18% color-mix tints.
Do draw new icons as inline SVG stroke glyphs (1.2–1.4 stroke, currentColor, 12×12 grid) matching render.ICONS.
Do run node --test dashboard/test/*.test.js before touching DOM ids, classes, or token names — 244 node tests are coupled to them.
donts: Don't rename any :root custom property (Variable-Name Freeze Rule) or hardcode #57b8ad where var(--accent-color) belongs.
Don't let chrome compete with the map: no saturated chrome fills, no decorative gradients outside the map stage, no second accent hue (Saturation Monopoly Rule).
Don't add external resources of any kind (fonts, CDNs, icon packages) — closed-network constraint; system faces only.
Don't cast neutral-black shadows, use hard offset shadows, or drop surface radii below the 8px floor — the soft tinted finish is the world.
Don't exceed the 10–16px type ramp in app chrome; hierarchy comes from weight, color, and the mono/sans split (Tight Operate Ramp Rule).
(resolved 2026-08-14) The formerly carried off-token literals in render.js — cluster badge and geo-retry banner — were retinted to current tokens (#1a2029/#e2e7ee); no carried defects remain.
